compatibility_rule: Whole-task evaluation requires attraction-only, feasible tasks. Flight, hotel, car, end-to-end budget, implicit-persona, and typed-infeasibility requirements are outside the current direct itinerary planner contract.
limitations: This is not a TREK planner score and makes no performance claim.
The audit does not use gold outputs or invoke any model/provider.
TREK data uses a synthetic world and must not be treated as real travel facts.
